name: Kneeling Leg Curl
description: Kneel on the machine's pad with the torso supported and the working ankle behind the roller, hips held extended rather than sitting back. Curl the heel toward the glute, squeezing the hamstring at the top, then lower slowly without letting the hips flex to help. One leg at a time, so each side gets its own load and its own honest rep count — the reason to pick this over a seated or lying curl when an asymmetry is the question. Keep the hips square and still; if they rotate or pike to finish the rep, the set is over.
